pages.initialPrompt:
Use case: illustration-story.
Create ONE finished children's picture-book page, landscape 16:9, approximately 1536x864. Page 1 of a consistent three-page art-direction sample for a Chinese early reader "我的花" ages 3–6. It must look like professionally art-directed mixed-media picture-book illustration, ready for a landscape phone screen, NOT a screenshot, NOT an app UI, NOT a book mockup.

STYLE: warm handcrafted gouache and cut-paper collage, tactile subtle paper fibers, softly irregular cut edges, colored-pencil accents, rich layered garden depth. Cream paper, sage and deep botanical green, soft sky blue; saturated coral-orange flower is the focus. Refined restrained detail, crisp legibility at small scale, soft morning light. Real photographic cutout head on a charming hand-painted paper-doll body is a deliberate aesthetic.
CHARACTER: one fictional East Asian boy, approximately five years old, friendly round cheeks, natural short black hair with a FULL rounded crown, smiling with a small open smile. The entire HEAD, ears and hair is PHOTO-REALISTIC with genuine photographic skin texture, NOT drawn, NOT 3D rendered, NOT a celebrity. Keep it LARGE, cute big-head doll proportions: head height roughly 40% of his full standing height. His body/hands/legs are entirely illustrated cut-paper, sage green long-sleeve shirt with cream patch pocket, ochre tan shorts, terracotta shoes. Harmonize the photo head's warmth with the painting, natural short neck entering shirt collar, tiny contact shadow, no sticker outline, no circle around face. Frontal face allows later real-photo replacement; no profile face.

SCENE: boy kneels/crouches in the left-center, gently sheltering his own single coral-orange flower with two open curved hands held on either side without touching or obscuring the petals. Sweet intimate storytelling, attentive delight. The flower grows directly from the ground, exactly ELEVEN individually visible broad rounded coral-orange petals around one small golden center, long slim stem with two leaves; head of flower is roughly half as wide as boy's head. Give the eleven petals room to be individually distinguishable and countable, not multiple overlapping rings. A tiny ochre snail on a leaf at lower left is a quiet secondary detail. No other flowers.
COMPOSITION: asymmetrical cinematic medium view. Layers of a few large foreground leaves at lower corners, child and flower midground, softly suggested receding garden shapes behind. Keep the whole head and all limbs inside generous margins. Rightmost 30% is calm clean warm ivory space, organically blended with illustration, no panel border.
TEXT: ONLY the exact Chinese sentence "我的小花。" in the upper middle of the calm RIGHT area, large dark green clear upright Chinese print, generous spacing, readable to early readers. No title, page label, subtitle, numbers, English, handwriting or watermarks.
AVOID: flat stock vector art, simplistic repeated circle-sun-and-grass composition, generic corporate illustration, 3D animation look, busy decorative flowers, extra petals, hyper-detailed garden clutter, realistic adult body, tiny head, cropped hair, photorealistic background or body.
pages.finalPrompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Refine this single landscape picture-book sample. Preserve the SAME fictional boy's photographic face and full rounded hair, Chinese text "我的小花。", landscape 16:9 composition, warm gouache/collage garden style and palette, lighting, large head, snail, and story action.
Change TWO things:
1. The boy's body must be a visibly CHARMING CARTOON PAPER DOLL beneath the real photographic head: smaller stubby torso and short limbs, rounded simplified mitten-like painted hands, smooth illustrated knees and legs with cut-paper edges. Keep sage green shirt with cream pocket, ochre shorts and terracotta shoes. Avoid realistic anatomical knuckles/skin pores on hands or legs. Keep crouching and sheltering flower, photographed HEAD only. Make head 1.2 times current size relative to small cute body while leaving full hair safely within frame. Neck connects naturally inside illustrated collar.
2. Replace just the flower corolla with exactly ELEVEN separate coral-orange paper petals in one ring around a small golden center. This is an educational counting book, accuracy critical. Arrange a single petal vertically at 12 o'clock, five distinct petals down the right side, five distinct petals down the left side; a small gap at 6 o'clock. Total is 1+5+5=11. Each petal has a distinct visible tip with small gap between neighbors, no hidden petals, no extra flower or detached petals. Keep green stem and two green leaves.
All other scene details and the text remain. Finish with an intentional tactile handcrafted children's-book quality, not a photograph of a child wearing paper clothes.

pages.prompt:
Use case: illustration-story. Create ONE NEW landscape 16:9 page from this SAME picture-book series, not a variation of the same pose.
Input reference: exact character identity, photographic head treatment, tactile gouache/cut-paper medium, clothes, garden, palette and typography from the supplied first page. Keep the SAME fictional five-year-old East Asian boy, same natural black hair FULL ROUND CROWN, same smile and round cheeks. Preserve photographic face, large cute head approx 40% of full standing height; body is charming STUBBY illustrated paper doll with simple rounded hands, sage green shirt/cream pocket, ochre shorts, cream socks, terracotta shoes. Not a realistic adult body and not a painted/cartoon face. Do not copy crouching pose.
STORY: first gust of wind. Boy in an energetic little tiptoe step in center-left, one knee lightly lifted, both arms reaching up and to the right to catch floating petals; head remains front-facing, lightly tilted so one real front photo could be used. Shirt hem and leaves lean with a left-to-right breeze. Clear playful silhouette, plausible joints, small body beneath large head.
The same single coral-orange flower stands at far LEFT at lower quarter, flower face directed toward viewer. Originally eleven petals, FOUR have just blown away. Show exactly SEVEN attached petals still around its golden center, with an obvious empty sector where four detached. Show exactly FOUR separate detached coral-orange petals following a broad airy curve across the left/center sky above his hands. Four petals clearly separate and easy to count, no overlap with face, no additional orange fragments/leaves/petal decorations. Educational count is exact: 7 attached + 4 airborne = 11. A single tiny ochre snail tucked on green leaf below flower. No other flowers.
COMPOSITION: wider, more dynamic shot than reference, child full standing/tiptoe body fits comfortably. Keep his head away from top edge. Flow from left flower to arc of petals to outstretched hands. Background same handmade garden with softened fence far away, fewer foreground leaves and more air/sky. Rightmost 30% clean continuous warm ivory reading space, not a rectangular panel.
TEXT only on right, large clear upright dark green Chinese print with deliberate two lines:
"一片两片"
"三四片，"
This is one sentence broken across two lines, exact characters and punctuation. No other text, labels, digits, arrows or watermark.
Polished children's picture-book artistry, subtle visible paper grain, gouache-rich green foliage with lively shapes and layered depth, restrained cream/sage/sky blue palette punctuated by coral-orange. Preserve reference's identity, face/illustration blend and materials, but make this a genuinely different moving composition.

Use case: illustration-story. Create ONE NEW finished landscape 16:9 page from this SAME picture-book series.
Input reference role: preserve the exact fictional five-year-old East Asian boy identity, smiling photographic face, full rounded short black hair, cute LARGE head and SMALL rounded paper-doll body, same sage-green cream-pocket shirt, ochre shorts, cream socks and terracotta shoes; preserve the warm handcrafted gouache/cut-paper garden and paper texture. The child searches, kneeling and leaning forward, two little illustrated hands gently parting tall green blades to either side. The small snail that was on the flower leaf now peeks curiously from a broad leaf near the child's left hand; small secondary discovery, not main subject. No visible coral-orange petals anywhere and no extra flowers.

Broad tactile foreground leaves frame bottom and left, midground boy face at center-left above hands and grass, receding lush garden behind. Entire crown well inside frame. Let hands push apart two groups of grass so the searching action is legible. Distinct layers, softness in distant garden, a few illuminated yellow-green blades lead eye to face. Rightmost 30% quiet warm ivory space organically fading from the garden, no bordered panel.
TEXT only in this quiet right area, large dark green clear upright Chinese reading print, exact two lines:
"飞入草丛"
"都不见。"
No additional title, labels, page number, icons, logos or watermark.
Warm surprising immersive ending, rich handmade paint and cut-paper textures, thoughtful negative space, sophisticated but very child-friendly, visually different from reference while unmistakably the same character/story. Keep counts honest: ALL petals hidden, no decorative orange petal lookalikes.
